question: what are the state of the art methods?
title: Compound Probabilistic Context-Free Grammars for Grammar Induction
answer_short: neural network-based approaches, compound probabilistic context-free grammar with continuous latent variable
answer_rationale: Text 1 mentions that the proposed approach is compared to recent state-of-the-art methods and performs effectively. Text 2 discusses neural network-based approaches as promising for grammar induction. Text 4 and Text 5 further support that the compound PCFG with a continuous latent variable and neural PCFG are state-of-the-art methods, as they outperform recent neural approaches and traditional PCFGs.
